result.brief: 证明 JEPA 在"良好视角"下跨模态学到同一表征（至多相差一个旋转），并给出对齐的缩放律；训练文本 JEPA 与 DINOv2/CLIP 图像编码器对齐，优于大语言模型。
result.reason: Theoretically proves JEPA-based cross-modal representation alignment, validates with text JEPA aligning to DINOv2/CLIP encoders; directly a visual/video representation learning contribution.
